scope: Broaden the open-source peer review with CADCraft's route-specific DXF/DWG matrix and cross-check its unknown-record claims against ACadRust's published raw entity paths; update the existing plan ledger without adding a peer or promoting support.

method.kind: Read-only review of current primary project documentation and published API/source documentation

sourcePinStatus.cadcraft: Mutable main documentation; app-reported behavior only.
sourcePinStatus.acadrust: Repository README advertises 0.6.4; docs.rs unknown-entity API page identifies 0.5.5 and latest source URLs are mutable. Do not attribute those source details to 0.6.4 without exact dependency/source pinning.
sourcePinStatus.opencadstudio_issue_1078: Already reviewed elsewhere in the plan; opened only as context, no new runtime or source pair checked.

method.evidenceBoundary: Project compatibility tables and public source comments are static capability/implementation evidence, not independently reproduced behavior. CADCraft/OpenCADStudio/ACadRust are one parser lineage. Raw-record transport does not establish typed semantics, graph closure, B-rep validity, or native acceptance.

findings.topic: CADCraft distinguishes native, raw, projected, and omitted DXF/DWG outcomes
observed: The app matrix describes ASCII and binary DXF support across R13-R2018, while naming feature-specific limitations such as flattened polyface/polygon meshes, folded MLEADER landings, regenerated dimension anonymous blocks, and retained foreign raw data.
For 3DSOLID, BODY, SURFACE, MESH and proxy entities, the matrix describes DXF raw-tag/CLASS preservation but says these raw-only records are dropped by its DWG save route.
The matrix describes foreign REGION input as unknown/raw but app-authored regions as closed polylines with CADCraft XDATA; this is not native ACIS REGION output.
Its aggregate DXF read/write percentages are explicitly estimated with weighted feature classes, not derived from a shared conformance benchmark.
findings.disposition: Same-lineage, application-documented route evidence only. Keep exact type/profile and output disposition per handle; no independent support vote.

findings.topic: ACadRust raw unknown paths are format- and source-profile-specific
observed: Published API/source separates raw DXF group-code pairs from raw DWG merged-stream payload bytes.

The DWG writer source documents same-source-profile raw passthrough and dropping an incompatible raw DWG record rather than reframing it; the DXF writer uses a separate unknown-entity raw path and filters references to objects that do not have a DXF representation.
The visible docs.rs unknown-entity API page identifies v0.5.5 while the repository README advertises v0.6.4, so the public source view does not prove behavior of the currently advertised release.
findings.disposition: Require exact app+codec source pins and separate DXF raw preservation, same-profile DWG pass-through, cross-version conversion, graph closure, and semantic results. No peer was run.

existingGatesRefined: Existing raw ENTITY/OBJECT/CLASSES and writer-graph test owners
